Amateur radio communications and educational training.
Description

Provide digital message relay service to the amateur radio community by means of an APRS digipeater onboard. Demonstrate a store-and-forward (S&F) system. Take photographs of the country, to study the situation of the glacier and lakes, and to do some basic communications?
Results
  • Strong CW.
  • Very few uplink success.
  • APRS beacon OK, but no uplink.
